name: Paliano
description: The capital of Fiora, where murder and subterfuge are common and political factions vie for control; its laws mystically bind the populace.

timeline.summary: Flashback: young Count Brago sees the potential of the City and recognizes he cannot walk the path to it alone.
timeline.quote: And he could not walk it alone.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Brago and Selvala work inseparably, build a coalition, and together draft the Charter that forges Paliano.
Marchesa entertains her longtime business partner Ervos Trax at dinner in her mansion in Paliano.
timeline.quote: Marchesa was entertaining a guest and business partner from the lowlands, Ervos Trax.

timeline.summary: Muzzio reveals his hidden workshop containing an army of constructs and a scale model of Paliano, and Irie pretends to see it for the first time.
timeline.quote: The centerpiece of the room, surrounded by whirring noises of various machines and the iron army, was a scale model of Paliano

timeline.summary: Paliano celebrates the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace while a lone sentry guards Fimarell's house.
timeline.quote: In the distance, the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace raged.

timeline.summary: After some time away, Daretti returns to Fiora to reshape the power structures of Paliano.
timeline.quote: After some time away, Daretti returned to Fiora to reshape the power structures of Paliano that denied him his aspirations.

relations.note: Brago is king of the High City.
relations.quote: The king, Brago, skin pale and cracked, like old parchment paper, rested in an ornate chair.

relations.note: Her mansion is among the elite homes of the High City.
relations.quote: Situated among the elite of Paliano, the High City

relations.note: She is crowned queen of the High City.
relations.quote: the velvet-drenched queen of the High City of Paliano

relations.note: She styles herself sole sovereign of the High City.
relations.quote: sole sovereign of the High City

pages_say.description: The High City on the plane of Fiora, full of intrigues, founded by Brago and Selvala's Charter.
The High City of Fiora where Marchesa's mansion stands.
The city of High and Low halves whose scale model Muzzio keeps in his hidden workshop.
The fiefdom or city where the Revari estate lies, a few miles from the haunted manor.
The city ruled by Brago and then Marchesa, in turmoil as Adriana rallies its people.
The city whose people Marchesa addresses and whose throne she claims.
The city whose free citizens Adriana addresses.
The city in political chaos where the Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace is held.
The city in political turmoil as Marchesa consolidates power.
The city on Fiora whose power structures denied Daretti his aspirations.
